晚上十一点。华侨城复式楼。

客厅里只留了一盏落地的暖光灯。沈蔓窝在宽大的真皮沙发里，身上套着林川那件宽大的黑衬衫，下摆堪堪遮住大腿根。她手里捧着一小碗切好的水果，正看着电视里的综艺节目，偶尔被逗得嘴角上扬。

林川洗完澡出来，带着一身淡淡的沐浴露香气，挨着她坐下。

沈蔓很自然地往他怀里靠了靠，用牙签扎了一块苹果递到他嘴边。

林川咬下苹果，伸手揽住她的腰，手指在她光滑的腿上无意识地摩挲了两下。

“过两天，我要去趟上海。”

林川笑着对沈曼说道。

沈蔓咀嚼的动作停住了。她转过头，看着林川的侧脸，眼神里那种慵懒的笑意一点点褪下去，取而代之的是一抹明显的失落。

“去多久？”她开口，声音比刚才低了八度。

“说不准。”林川拿过纸巾擦了擦手，“快的话十天半个月，慢的话，可能得在那边常驻一段时间。”

沈蔓没说话。她把手里的水果碗放在茶几上，低着头，手指抠着沙发边缘的缝隙。

她不想闹。她在这段关系里看得很清楚，林川不是那种能被女人用眼泪和撒娇拴在厨房里的男人。他的世界很大，大得让她有时候觉得心慌。

“那你刚把我哄好，就要跑。”沈蔓小声嘟囔了一句，语气里带着点委屈，但更多的是一种无可奈何的娇嗔。

林川笑了。他伸手捏了捏她的下巴，把她的脸抬起来。

“怎么，怕我在那边跑了？”

“上海的小姑娘多嗲啊。”沈蔓撇了撇嘴，眼眶微微有点泛红，“一口一个哥哥的，你别让人家几句软话就叫得找不着北了。”

“我连你这种天上飞的都能按得住，还怕几个嗲的？”林川语气里带着几分混不吝的痞气。

沈蔓被他这句话气笑了，伸手在他胸口轻轻捶了一下。“没正经。”

她深吸了一口气，从沙发上站起来，光着脚踩在厚厚的地毯上，转身往衣帽间走。

“干嘛去？”

“给你收拾东西。”沈蔓的声音从衣帽间里传出来，带着点鼻音，“你这人，穿衣服讲究，但从来不自己记着带。上海那边现在热，但写字楼里空调冷，得带两件薄外套。还有你惯用的那个剃须刀，酒店里的你肯定用不惯。”

林川靠在沙发上，看着那个在衣帽间里忙碌的高挑背影。

沈蔓这个女人，聪明就聪明在她的分寸感。她知道什么时候该黏人，什么时候该放手。

过了一会儿，沈蔓拎着几件叠好的衬衫走出来，塞进旁边的行李箱里。她又从自己的包里摸出一个小铁盒，塞进箱子的夹层。

“这什么？”林川问。

“我平时飞国际线常吃的薄荷糖。”沈蔓低着头拉拉链，“你抽烟凶，有时候开会连轴转嘴里没味儿，吃一颗能提提神。”

拉好拉链，她走回林川面前，跨坐在他腿上，双手搂住他的脖子。

“林川。”她盯着他的眼睛，极其认真。

“嗯。”

“我明天去趟排班室，找找静姐。”沈蔓咬了咬嘴唇，“我看看能不能把下个月的航线调一调。以后只要有飞上海的航班，我都尽量排进去。”

她不想只在深圳当一个等他回家的摆件。如果他的主战场转移了，那她就自己想办法跟过去。

林川看着她眼底那股清醒的倔强，心里那根弦被轻轻拨了一下。这才是他看上的女人。

“行。”林川双手托住她的腰，把她往怀里按了按，“只要你飞上海，落地告诉我，我去接你。”

沈蔓的眼睛瞬间亮了，眼底那点水汽被笑意彻底冲散。她低下头，重重地在他唇上咬了一口。

第二天下午两点。九州创投35楼。

电梯门一开，一股极其紧凑的商务压迫感扑面而来。

前台已经换成了一个穿着深色职业装、化着精致淡妆的女孩，无论是站姿还是接听电话的语调，都挑不出半点毛病。

宽敞的接待区里，坐着两拨人。一拨西装革履，正襟危坐，手里紧紧捏着牛皮纸袋；另一拨稍微休闲些，但眼神同样紧张，时不时低头核对一下手里的商业计划书。

看到林川走进来，办公区里原本就密集的键盘声和电话声似乎停滞了一瞬。所有人的余光都下意识地扫向那个穿着简单黑T恤的年轻人，眼神里透着一种近乎狂热的敬畏。

11pm.OCT duplex building.

There was only one floor-to-ceiling warm light left in the living room.Shen Man was nestled in the large leather sofa, wearing Lin Chuan's large black shirt, with the hem barely covering his thighs.She was holding a small bowl of cut fruit in her hand and was watching a variety show on TV, occasionally being amused so much that the corners of her mouth raised.

Lin Chuan came out of the shower, smelling faintly of shower gel, and sat down next to her.

Shen Man leaned into his arms naturally, pierced a piece of apple with a toothpick and handed it to his mouth.

Lin Chuan bit off the apple, put his arms around her waist, and unconsciously rubbed his fingers on her smooth legs twice.

"In two days, I'm going to Shanghai."

Lin Chuan said to Shen Man with a smile.

Shen Man stopped chewing.She turned her head and looked at Lin Chuan's side face. The lazy smile in her eyes faded little by little, replaced by an obvious look of loss.

"How long will it take?" she asked, her voice an octave lower than before.

"I can't say for sure." Lin Chuan took a tissue and wiped his hands. "If it's fast, it will take ten days and a half. If it's slow, I may have to stay there for a while."

Shen Man said nothing.She put the fruit bowl in her hand on the coffee table, lowered her head, and dug her fingers into the gaps on the edge of the sofa.

She didn't want to make a fuss.She saw very clearly in this relationship that Lin Chuan was not the kind of man who could be chained in the kitchen with women's tears and coquettishness.His world was so big that she sometimes felt flustered.

"Then you've just finished coaxing me, and you're about to run away." Shen Man muttered in a low voice, with a bit of grievance in his tone, but more of a helpless coquettishness.

Lin Chuan smiled.He reached out and pinched her chin, lifting her face up.

"What, are you afraid that I'll run away over there?"

"The little girls in Shanghai are so talkative." Shen Man curled her lips and her eyes were slightly red, "Everything is like a brother. Don't let others make you confused with a few soft words."

"I can even hold down someone like you who is flying in the sky, so why am I afraid of a few people snoring?" Lin Chuan said with a hint of ruthlessness in his tone.

Shen Man laughed angrily at his words and stretched out her hand to lightly punch his chest."Not serious."

She took a deep breath, stood up from the sofa, stepped on the thick carpet with her bare feet, turned and walked to the cloakroom.

"Why go?"

"Pack your things." Shen Man's voice came out from the cloakroom, with a nasal sound, "You are a person who is very particular about clothes, but you never remember to bring them yourself. It's hot in Shanghai now, but the air conditioning in the office building is cold, so you have to bring two thin coats. And the razor you are used to, you must not be used to it in the hotel."

Lin Chuan leaned on the sofa and looked at the tall figure busy in the cloakroom.

Shen Man, a woman, is smart because of her sense of proportion.She knows when to be clingy and when to let go.

After a while, Shen Man came out carrying a few folded shirts and stuffed them into the suitcase next to him.She took out a small iron box from her bag and stuffed it into the compartment of the box.

"What is this?" Lin Chuan asked.

"I usually eat mint candies when flying internationally." Shen Man lowered his head and unzipped the zipper, "You smoke a lot, and sometimes you have no taste in your mouth when you are in a meeting. Eating one can refresh you."

After zipping up, she walked back to Lin Chuan, straddled his lap, and put her arms around his neck.

"Linchuan." She stared into his eyes extremely seriously.

"Yeah."

"I'll go to the scheduling room tomorrow and look for Sister Jing." Shen Man bit her lip, "I'll see if I can adjust the route for next month. In the future, whenever there are flights to Shanghai, I will try my best to get them in."

She didn't want to just be a decoration in Shenzhen waiting for him to come home.If his main battlefield moved, she would find a way to follow him.

Lin Chuan looked at the sober stubbornness in her eyes, and the string in his heart was gently plucked.This is the woman he likes.

"Okay." Lin Chuan held her waist with both hands and pressed her into his arms, "As long as you fly to Shanghai and tell me when you land, I will pick you up."

Shen Man's eyes lit up instantly, and the moisture in his eyes was completely washed away by his smile.She lowered her head and bit his lips hard.

Two o'clock in the afternoon the next day.35th floor, Jiuzhou Venture Capital.

As soon as the elevator door opened, an extremely tight sense of business pressure hit us.

The front desk has been replaced by a girl wearing dark business attire and delicate light makeup. No matter whether she is standing or answering the phone, there is nothing wrong with her.

There were two groups of people sitting in the spacious reception area.One group of people were in suits and leather shoes, sitting upright, holding brown paper bags tightly in their hands; the other group was a little more casual, but their eyes were equally nervous, and they lowered their heads from time to time to check the business plan in their hands.

Seeing Lin Chuan walk in, the already dense sound of keyboards and phone calls in the office area seemed to stop for a moment.Everyone's peripheral vision subconsciously glanced at the young man wearing a simple black T-shirt, with an almost fanatical awe in his eyes.
